discourse.excerpt: The Lord will respond even if you call Him just once from the depths of feeling; He will be deaf, even if you call Him a million times, automatically, artificially, with the tongue not with the heart.
discourse.theme: God answers one call from the depths of feeling — not a million mechanical repetitions.
discourse.title: Diagnose Your Own Disease

reflection: Swami says the Lord answers a single call from the depths of feeling, and is deaf to a million mechanical repetitions. Today, call the Name once — slowly, and meaning it. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4, 17 Dec 1964)
seva_nudge: Offer a ride to the next Sunday bhajan at Sai Prema Nilayam Riverside to someone who otherwise could not come — and sing one bhajan with your whole heart.
